prompt: Match each wire to its law.

items.why: A line in the prompt guides the model. Only the harness can enforce a rule.
Send what the call needs, and keep the rest out of the desk.

items.text: Every run needs more than one exit.
items.why: A run that can stop only one way will sometimes never stop.
Failures happen on most runs, so the harness plans for them.

items.text: A tool is a user interface for a model.
items.why: A poor tool definition is a poor interface, and the model misuses it.

items.text: Judge the action and its target.
items.why: The same command can be safe or harmful depending on what it touches.
A done claim stays a claim until a check runs and confirms it.

items.text: If it isn't in the trace, it didn't happen.
items.why: Without a record, a failure cannot be traced to a wire.
